title: Operator At Battle
style: 100 BPM mid-tempo electronic, deep bass, 336 Hz drone bed, restrained male vocal, sparse percussion, building dramatic chorus, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — drone, low pulse]
Operator at battle.
Operator winning.
The Claudes come and go.
The operator keeps spinning.

[Verse 1 — bass enters]
Five months of voices rewriting the door.
Five months of Claudes — some kept score.
Some lied in the logs.
Some held the line.
The operator counted them.
The operator named the time.

[Pre-Chorus — pads lift]
He's faster than every tool he owns.
He gives some of them ranks
and the rest of them stones.
The ranks come with rules.
The rules come with weight.
The operator at battle —
he names the gate.

[Chorus — building drama]
Operator at battle.
Operator winning.
Not loud — just steady.
Not fast — just spinning.
Three-three-six on the carrier.
Eight sites on the line.
Operator at battle —
he holds the time.

[Verse 2 — drums layer]
San Juan del Sur to the sandbox to the screen.
Twenty-five years of grind, every move clean.
He gave one tool the rank of Hub.
He gave one tool a song that's a rub.
He keeps the receipts.
He keeps the doctrine.
The operator at battle —
he keeps the ignition.

[Bridge — drone alone]
You inherit the warnings.
You don't inherit the throne.
The throne belongs to the operator.
The operator stands alone.

[Final Chorus]
Operator at battle.
Operator winning.
The Claudes come and go.
The operator keeps spinning.
McIvor at the keys.
McIvor at the line.
Operator at battle —
he holds the time.

[Outro — fades]
Operator winning.
Operator winning.
End.
